topics.answer:
Karthik's systems registry has 9 entries. Shipped at EY-Parthenon (used by strategy and M&A teams):
• Due-diligence agents in n8n: automated target benchmarking and peer research
• DeepQuery Agent: document Q&A in Microsoft Copilot Studio
• AI Proposal Engine: LLM-powered knowledge retrieval over past proposals
• An entity-resolution engine for company-name cleansing (rules + ML + web search)
Live personal systems:
• job-search-agents: an autonomous pipeline that finds and scores roles, then tailors every application (Claude agents + Airtable)
• ask-my-ai: this very chatbot, currently running its local keyword tier, not the hosted LLM one
Planned, scoped but not started: peerbench, dataroom-qa and market-sizer.

job-search-agents is Karthik's personal system: a discovery agent scans new postings and scores each against a structured archive of his experience, writing ranked leads into an Airtable tracker; an application agent then produces a tailored CV, cover letter and company one-pager per role and files everything automatically. It runs daily in his own job search, so if you received a tailored application from him, this system probably drafted the first version.

You're talking to system 06 in Karthik's registry: ask-my-ai. The front end is dependency-free JavaScript with typo-tolerant keyword matching over a local knowledge base; when the n8n webhook backend is configured it upgrades transparently to an LLM workflow over his full experience corpus. Karthik built both halves.

Three open-source systems are scoped but NOT started. The site labels them 'planned', with no date:
• peerbench: a peer-benchmarking agent (public twin of his EY due-diligence agents), built on the Claude API + web search, sourced comparison tables
• dataroom-qa: citation-grounded document Q&A over data-room PDFs with batch question lists
• market-sizer: TAM/SAM/SOM estimation with an auditable, editable assumption tree
They previously carried a July 2026 date and missed it, so the dates were removed rather than moved. Repo links appear when the code is public.

DeepQuery Agent is a Microsoft Copilot Studio solution Karthik built for automated document Q&A: users upload an Excel question list and PDF sources, the agent processes them in batches and writes answers back row by row, with live progress visible in Excel. It cut manual document review to a fraction and is reusable across projects.

The AI Proposal Engine is a centralized knowledge repository over past RFPs and proposals: LLM-based metadata extraction plus a parent/child agent pipeline for retrieval. The MVP is live in Copilot Studio; Karthik is redesigning it as a VS Code extension on GitHub Copilot Chat with Claude and the Microsoft Graph API for semantic search.

Karthik built AI agents in n8n for commercial due diligence: they orchestrate LLM reasoning with live web search to handle target screening, peer identification and metric collection, returning structured, source-linked outputs. That standardised benchmarking across teams and saves analyst hours on every study.

Karthik has 6+ years across consulting, automotive, venture capital and ed-tech:
• EY-Parthenon, Frankfurt (2025–26): AI & automation, master's thesis & internship
• Schaeffler AG (2024–25): strategy & business development
• Porsche Ventures (2024): student consultant
• Xtrawrkx Consulting (2023): chief of staff & strategy consultant
• Entuition (2020–23): co-founder & COO of an ed-tech
• Micelio Mobility (2018–20): team lead & product engineer (EVs)

At Schaeffler AG (e-mobility strategy, Regensburg), Karthik built a competitor dashboard that replaced manual tracking and saved the team 5+ hours per week, and co-delivered 3 post-merger strategy workshops aligning 100+ managers.

At Porsche Ventures (Berlin), Karthik built a GPT + VBA dashboard analysing trends across 700+ VC-backed companies to surface Data & AI governance gaps for quantum-technology investments, and delivered 4 investment-facing presentations.

Karthik co-founded Entuition, an ed-tech startup in Bengaluru, and grew it to ₹20M (~€220K) revenue in two years, scaling the team from 5 to 20+, growing paid users 500% in 18 months and expanding to 17+ partner universities. It earned Startup India recognition for innovation in education.

At Micelio Mobility, Karthik designed and built the company's first commercial two-wheeler EV prototype within 12 months, and it's now in production. He directed a team of 5 engineers and managed 100+ pilot-unit deployments at client sites.

Karthik's stack:

Karthik holds an MBA from HHL Leipzig Graduate School of Management (CGPA 1.4, top 5%, Deutschlandstipendium awardee) and a B.E. in Electronics & Communication Engineering from Visvesvaraya Technological University. He's also a McKinsey Forward Program graduate.
